ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Attempt Via Run Keys Using Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious command line reg.exe tool adding key to RUN key in Registry

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*reg.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ add\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\WOW6432Node\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\Run.*")))
